newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen steady at current firm levels.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen steady at current firm levels.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Monday were expected to remain steady as buyers may be sidelined by the current high levels, brokers said.
Cst 180 fuel oil supplies for loading in October was bid/asked at $115/$117 per tonne.
"Current prices are too high," said a buyer. "We may just wait for levels to edge lower. But the high levels were also discouraging a seller to offer his supplies on a floating basis.
The seller is afraid that prices may correct lower or be pushed down after he had sold his cargoes, the buyer said.
In the swaps market, October fuel oil paper was indicated at $114.50/$115.50, slightly lower from Friday's quotes at $115.25/$116, amid slightly softer crude levels.
The seller said there is currently no "overhang" in supplies with demand from China still expected to be strong.

But Kuwait is expected to increase export as the country's summer season ends. Traders have mixed views on Kuwaiti exports. Some said supplies have already been commited while others said there are still cargoes that have yet to be sold.
